title: Pricing Page Tiers, Billing Toggle, Calculator, FAQ, and CTA Routing Verification
objective: Verify the TestRadius pricing page displays all five tiers with correct initial pricing and badges, correctly toggles between monthly and annual rates, calculates team costs accurately upon dev count change, expands FAQ items on click, and routes the primary Free tier CTA to signup without application errors.

model_verification.note: Live model/tool verification requires GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY and network access; record verified model IDs/date during 008.4 spike or production setup.

preconditions.description: Public internet connectivity available to reach https://testradius.dev
Visitor session in clean state with no active authentication cookies required

stop_conditions: HTTP status 5xx or unhandled fatal client crash on pricing page
data_handling: Do not submit credit card details or finalize any subscription payment

cases.title: Verify Pricing Page Initial Load, Five Tier Cards, and Monthly Rates

steps.intent: Navigate to the TestRadius pricing page and verify page status and layout

target.description: Browser address bar navigation to the pricing route

success_criteria: Current URL contains 'testradius.dev/pricing'
Page title or main H1 heading related to Pricing is visible
'Launch pricing' badge and '30-day money-back guarantee on paid plans' text are visible
Billing toggle ('Pay monthly' / 'Pay annually') with 'Save 17%' badge is visible on this top view
No unhandled application errors or HTTP 4xx/5xx error pages
fallback_instructions: Reload the page if initial load hangs after 15 seconds

steps.intent: Page-down once so the plan card prices enter the viewport
success_criteria: Free tier card visible with '$0' text
Starter tier card visible showing '$79'
Growth tier card visible showing '$25'
Scale tier card visible showing '$19'
Enterprise tier card visible showing '$1,499'
failure_signals: Missing any of the 5 tier cards
Billing toggle or Save 17% badge not visible
fallback_instructions: Scroll down slightly if hero section pushes cards below viewport fold

steps.intent: Confirm plan card features and call-to-action buttons are shown

target.description: Guarantee text and promotional disclaimer notes

success_criteria: At least three plan cards show feature bullets (e.g. 'Full shadow mode analysis', 'Automated test selection', 'Slack integration')
Plan call-to-action buttons are visible ('Get Started Free', 'Start Trial', or 'Contact Sales')

cases.title: Verify Annual Billing Toggle Price Updates

steps.intent: Switch billing toggle to Pay annually

target.description: Annual billing switch or toggle button

success_criteria: Billing toggle shifts active state to 'Pay annually'
No page refresh error or unexpected redirection occurs
fallback_instructions: Click the toggle slider directly if text label is not actionable

steps.intent: Page-down once so the plan card annual prices enter the viewport

target.description: Updated pricing tier figures in cards

success_criteria: Free tier card remains '$0' / Free tier
Starter card displays '$790'
Growth card displays '$250' with annual billing marker
Scale card displays '$190'
'2 months free' or equivalent annual-billing marker is visible on paid plan cards
fallback_instructions: Wait 2 seconds for CSS transition/DOM re-render before evaluation

cases.title: Verify Team Cost Calculator Dynamic Calculation

steps.intent: Page-down until the Team Cost Calculator section is visible
success_criteria: Team Cost Calculator heading and input controls are fully visible in the viewport
failure_signals: Calculator section not found on page
fallback_instructions: Scroll down 800px increments until calculator heading appears

steps.intent: Update developer count to 10 in the calculator

target.description: Developer count input field or slider control in Team Cost Calculator
target.label: Developers

success_criteria: Input field or slider value reflects 10 developers
failure_signals: Input field disabled or non-responsive to keystrokes
fallback_instructions: Select all text with backspace/delete before typing '10', or drag slider handle to 10

steps.intent: Assert estimated cost and recommended plan update for 10 developers

target.description: Calculated total price and plan tier readout in calculator

success_criteria: Calculated output displays recommendation matching Growth tier (6–25 devs)
Total calculated cost reflects 10 developers (e.g. $250/mo or $2,500/yr depending on billing toggle)
No calculation NaN or negative number visible
failure_signals: Output shows NaN, 0, or unchanged starter values
Calculated price does not match expected tier rates
fallback_instructions: Trigger a blur or Enter key event on the input if auto-calculation requires change event

steps.intent: Page-down until the FAQ section is visible
success_criteria: FAQ section header and question items are visible in viewport
fallback_instructions: Scroll directly towards bottom of page

steps.intent: Click the FAQ question 'Can I cancel anytime?' to expand its accordion content

target.description: Accordion trigger button for question 'Can I cancel anytime?'
target.selector_hint: button:has-text('Can I cancel anytime?'), summary:has-text('Can I cancel anytime?')

success_criteria: The FAQ item expands into active/open state
Accordion answer text becomes visible under 'Can I cancel anytime?'
Answer content confirms cancellation terms without layout overlap
failure_signals: Answer text remains hidden or collapsed
fallback_instructions: Click directly on the plus/chevron icon next to the question title

cases.title: Verify Free Plan CTA Routing to Signup

steps.intent: Return to the top of the pricing page so the Free plan card is visible
success_criteria: Free tier card and 'Get Started Free' CTA button are clearly in view
failure_signals: Free tier card or button not found
fallback_instructions: Scroll to top of the page

steps.intent: Click the 'Get Started Free' button inside the FREE plan card (the leftmost card). Do not submit the 'Request Early Access' form at the bottom of the page.

target.description: Primary CTA button in Free plan card
target.selector_hint: a:has-text('Get Started Free'), button:has-text('Get Started Free')

success_criteria: Browser navigates to a valid signup, register, or auth URL (e.g. /signup, /register, or /auth)
Target page renders a registration or authentication form without 4xx/5xx HTTP errors
Navigation remains within allowed domain 'testradius.dev'
failure_signals: HTTP 404 or 500 error page on navigation
Button click produces no action or navigation
Page directs to unauthorized third-party payment form directly without signup
fallback_instructions: If click opens in new tab, switch context to active window; otherwise verify href attribute

postconditions: Browser window closed and temporary navigation session ended without saved state
oracle_notes: Plan pass requirement: All 5 tiers must be rendered with matching names (Free, Starter, Growth, Scale, Enterprise).
Growth tier must carry a 'Most Popular' badge or clear visual highlight.
Billing toggle must dynamically update figures between monthly and annual rates (Starter $79 -> $790, Growth $25 -> $250, Scale $19 -> $190).
Team Cost Calculator must calculate cost dynamically when developer input is adjusted to 10.
Accordion expansion must display readable textual answer for 'Can I cancel anytime?'.
CTA navigation for the Free tier must reach a valid signup/login page with no client or server errors.
execution_hints_for_computer_use: Wait 1 to 2 seconds after clicking the Pay annually toggle to allow DOM price transitions to settle.
For calculator input, ensure existing text is cleared or overwritten before typing target value 10.
Ensure scrolling brings elements into the middle of the viewport to avoid fixed header obstruction.

coverage_notes: Covers 5 pricing tier cards and Most Popular badge verification
Covers Pay monthly vs Pay annually toggle with Save 17% badge
Covers Team Cost Calculator interactivity with 10 developers
Covers Get Started Free CTA routing without completing destructive transactions
